structured.answer: I'd lean to Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track (fund 13254): Harel is a big name, it shows 0% shares and 0% foreign currency, 4.25% a year over 3 years and 3.08% over 5, with a 0.57% management fee. But I won't do anything before I ask my son or the bank.

I didn't know if this means a loss or just a new track. Most rows say it instead of a number.
I noticed late that the returns are before the fee, so I don't know what I really get.
Tired, too many numbers. I stopped after screen 6.
